context:
# Goal
mori-shokunin round 20 (fleet/host observability: fleet liveness, wave settlement, kill/OOM events, resource runway; detection and report only). L1 MoriR20 is the single integration owner and holds the planner seat. Frozen claim contract (read it first): /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mori-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-20/contract.md. C1 freshness: classify every live drift token of the census against the r10 baseline and re-pin. C2 coverage: new read-only per-seat wave-settlement tool tools/mori-wave-settlement.py, oracle /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mori-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-20/frozen/c2-expected.json.

# Paths and reports
Every path is absolute under /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mori-shokunin. Every `Report:` trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mori-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mori-shokunin/<that path>, never under /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin. Your FIRST tool call writes the single line `STATUS: started` to that report path; your LAST action overwrites it with your final report (markdown, findings with path:line or command+output evidence; mark anything unobserved [INFERENCE]). Candidate code or drafts go only under /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mori-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-20/build/<YourSeatName>/ .

# Bounds
Read-only on: the fleet repo /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin (MANIFEST.json, scripts/, templates/, .ufo/state/*, .ufo/watchdog.log), every sibling lane repo, ~/.omp, host services. Never edit /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mori-shokunin/tools/mori-census.sh, any committed baseline, lane production files, the lane jj state or Git index; never run git/jj mutating commands (add, commit, checkout, stash, reset, jj new/describe/...). Never open retained interactive-session transcripts or ~/.omp session logs. Never message agent://all; message seats only by exact id. Leaf seat: no subagents, no swarms (an executor may spawn at most one read-only labrat). Do not run builds/linters/formatters or full lane selftests unless your item says to run something; the L1 runs acceptance once after integration. Do not run tools/mori-census.sh unless your item explicitly says so (it takes ~2 min and heavy CPU).

# Tooling
Tool installs are authorized for helpful tools after reading /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md: official channels only; record tool, version, channel and reason in your report. pacman guard: ALL pacman transactions are PAUSED host-wide (orchestrator ruling 2026-10-20) — use uv tool / npx / an official binary in ~/.local/bin instead, or report the need. Never -Sy/-Syu/-U/-R, never restart a host service.

# Honesty
An unrun check has not passed. A missing report is not a dead seat. Never fabricate output, URLs, quotes or counts.
